title.english: The Other Side of the Letter

pairs.target: xìn sòngdào dōng yuàn shí , tǎ wéi zhèng bǎ yǐzi dǎo guòlái , zhǎo yìméi diào jìn zhuān fèng de zhēn .
pairs.english: When the letter reached the east courtyard, Tavi was turning a chair upside down to find a needle that had fallen between the bricks.
pairs.hanzi: 信送到东院时，塔维正把椅子倒过来，找一枚掉进砖缝的针。

pairs.target: lái sòngxìn de xuéshēng zài ménkǒu niàn tā de míngzì , niàn le liǎngbiàn , tā cái fǎnyìng guòlái .
pairs.english: The student delivering it read his name from the doorway twice before he registered it.
pairs.hanzi: 来送信的学生在门口念他的名字，念了两遍，他才反应过来。

pairs.target: pà wò cóng chuángshàng tàn chūtóu , gàosù nà rén jiùshì zhège pāzhe de .
pairs.english: Pavo poked his head out from his bed and told the student it was the one on all fours.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃从床上探出头，告诉那人就是这个趴着的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān bǎ zhēn zhǎo chūlái , zhā huí zhēn bāo , zài qù jiē xìn .
pairs.english: Tavi found the needle first, stuck it back in its case, and then took the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先把针找出来，扎回针包，再去接信。

pairs.target: fēngkǒu nián dé hěn kuān , bèimiàn xiě zhe bó yà de míngzì .
pairs.english: The sealed edge was pasted wide, with Boya's name written on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 封口粘得很宽，背面写着博娅的名字。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài ménbiān , yòng mǔzhǐ mō le yíxià nà jǐgè zì .
pairs.english: He stood by the door and brushed his thumb over those characters.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在门边，用拇指摸了一下那几个字。

pairs.target: jīntiān shì lái xuégōng hòu de dìqītiān .
pairs.english: This was his seventh day at the school.
pairs.hanzi: 今天是来学宫后的第七天。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ méiyǒu kè , tā yuánběn dǎsuàn bǎ nà zhāng zhī bì tú shàng de biāozhù bǔqí .
pairs.english: With no lessons that morning, he had meant to finish labeling his drawing of the support arm.
pairs.hanzi: 上午没有课，他原本打算把那张支臂图上的标注补齐。

pairs.target: tú yǐjīng néng ràng rén kàn dǒng le , zhǐshì " dǐzuò " de zuò zì zǒng shǎo yìdiǎn , mǐlā ná tā xiào guò tā , shuō zhào zhège tú zuò , yǐzi jiù dé quē yìtiáo tuǐ .
pairs.english: The drawing was understandable now, but he kept missing a dot in the word for “base.” Mira had teased him that a chair made from this drawing would be missing a leg.
pairs.hanzi: 图已经能让人看懂了，只是“底座”的座字总少一点，米拉拿它笑过他，说照这个图做，椅子就得缺一条腿。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xìn dàidào dōng yuàn wài de táijiē shàng , zuòzài yīnyǐng lǐ mànmàn chāi .
pairs.english: He took the letter to the steps outside the east courtyard, sat in the shade, and slowly opened it.
pairs.hanzi: 他把信带到东院外的台阶上，坐在阴影里慢慢拆。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng dìyīháng hěn duānzhèng : tǎ wéi , jiālǐ yíqiè zhàocháng .
pairs.english: The first line was very neat: Tavi, everything at home is as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上第一行很端正：塔维，家里一切照常。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn lìng qǐ yìháng , zì hūrán jǐ le qǐlái .
pairs.english: On a new line below, the writing suddenly grew crowded.
pairs.hanzi: 下面另起一行，字忽然挤了起来。

pairs.target: " zhè jù shì bó yà xiě de . wǒ méi shuō yíqiè zhàocháng . " tā yíxià xiào le .
pairs.english: “Boya wrote that. I never said everything was as usual.” He laughed at once.
pairs.hanzi:
“这句是博娅写的。我没说一切照常。”
他一下笑了。

pairs.target: sè lā shuō , gébì de xiǎogūniáng tì tā bān wán méi , nálái yào gǎi de wàiyī , xiùzǐ cháng dé néng bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu dōu cángjìnqù .
pairs.english: Sela said the little girl next door had finished carrying coal for her, then brought the coat for altering, its sleeves long enough to hide both hands.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说，隔壁的小姑娘替她搬完煤，拿来要改的外衣，袖子长得能把两只手都藏进去。

pairs.target: gūniáng jiānchí zhè shì dàrén de yàngshì , sè lā zhǐhǎo xiānfèng yìbiān , ràng tā chuānzhe shì .
pairs.english: The girl insisted it was the grown-up style, so Sela sewed just one side first and let her try it on.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘坚持这是大人的样式，瑟拉只好先缝一边，让她穿着试。

pairs.target: tā yòng lìngyìbiān de chángxiù cā bízi , bèi mǔqīn kànjiàn le , dìèrzhī xiùzǐ lìkè yě biànduǎn le .
pairs.english: Her mother caught her wiping her nose with the other long sleeve, and the second sleeve immediately became shorter too.
pairs.hanzi: 她用另一边的长袖擦鼻子，被母亲看见了，第二只袖子立刻也变短了。

pairs.target: dú dào zhèlǐ , tǎ wéi tíngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Tavi paused there in his reading.
pairs.hanzi: 读到这里，塔维停下来。

pairs.target: yuànmén páng yǒurén tuō zhe yìkǔn sàozhou guòqù , zhú shāo guāguò dìmiàn , fāchū gāngānde xiǎngshēng .
pairs.english: Someone dragged a bundle of brooms past the gate, their bamboo tips scraping the ground with a dry rustle.
pairs.hanzi: 院门旁有人拖着一捆扫帚过去，竹梢刮过地面，发出干干的响声。

pairs.target: tā fǎngfú kànjiàn jiāménkǒu nà kuài bùpíng de shítou , xiǎogūniáng yídìng zhàn zài shàng miànshì yīfu , sè lā zuò zhe , cái nénggòu dào tā de xiùkǒu .
pairs.english: He could almost see the uneven stone outside home: the girl must be standing on it to try the coat, so Sela could reach her cuffs while sitting.
pairs.hanzi: 他仿佛看见家门口那块不平的石头，小姑娘一定站在上面试衣服，瑟拉坐着，才能够到她的袖口。

pairs.target: wǎng xià jǐháng , zì yòu xiǎo le xiē .
pairs.english: A few lines farther down, the writing grew smaller again.
pairs.hanzi: 往下几行，字又小了些。

pairs.target: ā duó sòng shuǐ de shíhòu , bǎ fènghǎo de wàiyī chuān fǎn le , wèn wèishénme kǒudài mōbúdào .
pairs.english: When Ado brought water, he had his mended coat on inside out and asked why he couldn't find the pockets.
pairs.hanzi: 阿铎送水的时候，把缝好的外衣穿反了，问为什么口袋摸不到。

pairs.target: xīgài háishì lǎo yàngzi , méiyǒu bǐ tā zǒu qián gèng téng .
pairs.english: Her knees were the same, no worse than before he left.
pairs.hanzi: 膝盖还是老样子，没有比他走前更疼。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí zhuāng yàngpǐn de huó hái méiyǒu xiāoxī , sè lā shuō zhīdào le jiù gàosù tā , búyòng gé liǎngtiān wèn yícì .
pairs.english: There was no news of a second sample-packing job yet. Sela said she'd tell him when she knew; no need to ask every other day.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回装样品的活还没有消息，瑟拉说知道了就告诉他，不用隔两天问一次。

pairs.target: tā qíshí zhī xiě guò yìfēngxìn .
pairs.english: In fact, he'd only written one letter.
pairs.hanzi: 他其实只写过一封信。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòng zhǐ fù yā zhe nà xíng zì , xiǎng le xiǎng , juéde tā shì zài yùxiān dǔ tā de zuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi pressed his fingertip to the line, thought a moment, and decided she was silencing him in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维用指腹压着那行字，想了想，觉得她是在预先堵他的嘴。

pairs.target: zài xiàmiàn yǒu liǎnggè zì , tā rènbùchū , qiánhòu dú le jǐbiàn yě méi nòngdǒng .
pairs.english: Farther down were two characters he couldn't recognize; reading around them several times didn't help.
pairs.hanzi: 再下面有两个字，他认不出，前后读了几遍也没弄懂。

pairs.target: zhènghǎo mǐlā cóngxiǎo lùshang guòlái , gēbo xià jiá zhe yì běnshū , kànjiàn tā , jiǎobù màn le xiàlái .
pairs.english: Just then Mira came along the path with a book under her arm and slowed when she saw him.
pairs.hanzi: 正好米拉从小路上过来，胳膊下夹着一本书，看见他，脚步慢了下来。

pairs.target: " jiālǐ de ? " tā diǎntóu , bǎ zhǐ zhé qǐ , zhī liúchū nà yìháng .
pairs.english: “From home?” He nodded and folded the paper, leaving only that line visible.
pairs.hanzi:
“家里的？”
他点头，把纸折起，只留出那一行。

pairs.target: " zhè liǎnggè zěnme niàn ? " tā dūnxiàlái , kàojìn yìdiǎn kàn .
pairs.english: “How do you read these two?” She crouched and leaned closer to look.
pairs.hanzi:
“这两个怎么念？”
她蹲下来，靠近一点看。

pairs.target: " diànjì . shuō tā diànjì nǐ , jiào nǐ bié bǎ wàzi chuān dào pò le cái bǔ . "
pairs.english: “Thinking of you. She says she's thinking of you, and not to wait until your socks have holes before mending them.”
pairs.hanzi: “惦记。说她惦记你，叫你别把袜子穿到破了才补。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe zhǐ . qián bànjù hěn duǎn , hòu bànjù zhàn le hǎo cháng yì jié .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the paper. The first half was short, the second stretched much farther.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着纸。前半句很短，后半句占了好长一截。

pairs.target: tā gāngcái yìzhí rènde wàzi , què méi dú dào qiánmiàn qù .
pairs.english: He'd recognized “socks” all along, yet hadn't reached what came before.
pairs.hanzi: 他刚才一直认得袜子，却没读到前面去。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ shū cóng yèxià huàn dào shǒulǐ , méiyǒu shùnzhe wǎng xià kàn .
pairs.english: Mira moved the book from under her arm to her hand, without reading farther down.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把书从腋下换到手里，没有顺着往下看。

pairs.target: " nǐ yào xiě huíxìn ma ? xī láng yǒu zhāng kōng zhuō , nàlǐ bǐ zhèér liàng . "
pairs.english: “Will you write back? There's an empty table in the west gallery. It's brighter than here.”
pairs.hanzi: “你要写回信吗？西廊有张空桌，那里比这儿亮。”

pairs.target: xìn de mòwěi , bó yà lìngwài tiān le yíjù , shuō sè lā zuìhòu yòu ràng tā bǔ shàng " fàn yào chī gòu ", yīnwèi tǎ wéi wèn dé tài duō , tā hái méiyǒu jīhuì shuō .
pairs.english: At the end Boya added that Sela had finally asked her to include “Eat enough,” because Tavi asked so many questions she hadn't had a chance to say it.
pairs.hanzi: 信的末尾，博娅另外添了一句，说瑟拉最后又让她补上“饭要吃够”，因为塔维问得太多，她还没有机会说。

pairs.target: zhǐbiān hái huà zhe yígè xiǎo wǎn , wǎndǐ hěn yuán , xiàng zài huàng .
pairs.english: A little bowl was drawn in the margin too, its bottom so round it seemed to wobble.
pairs.hanzi: 纸边还画着一个小碗，碗底很圆，像在晃。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ nà yìjiǎo zǐxì yāpíng , gēn mǐlā qù le xī láng .
pairs.english: Tavi carefully smoothed that corner and went with Mira to the west gallery.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把那一角仔细压平，跟米拉去了西廊。

pairs.target: tā zhǎo lái de zhuōzi shǎo le yìtiáo héng chēng , shǒuzhǒu yì yā jiù yáo .
pairs.english: The table she'd found lacked a cross-brace and rocked under an elbow.
pairs.hanzi: 她找来的桌子少了一条横撑，手肘一压就摇。

pairs.target: liǎng rén shì zhe diàn le yípiàn mùtou , réngjiù bù wěn , suǒxìng huàn dào pángbiān de chuāngtái , gè zhàn yìbiān .
pairs.english: They tried wedging a piece of wood under it, but it stayed unsteady, so they moved to the window ledge beside it, one at each end.
pairs.hanzi: 两人试着垫了一片木头，仍旧不稳，索性换到旁边的窗台，各占一边。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒu liàngzhe de cháng bù , bèi fēngchuī qǐlái , shíbushí zhēzhù guāng .
pairs.english: Long cloth hung drying outside, billowing in the wind and blocking the light from time to time.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有晾着的长布，被风吹起来，时不时遮住光。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu zài xiě " dōu hǎo ".
pairs.english: Tavi didn't write “All well” again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有再写“都好”。

pairs.target: tā xiě fàntáng de tāng lǐ yǒu yìzhǒng tā bú rènshi de yèzi , kǔ guò yǐhòu huì tián ;
pairs.english: He wrote about a leaf he didn't recognize in the dining-hall soup, bitter at first, then sweet;
pairs.hanzi: 他写饭堂的汤里有一种他不认识的叶子，苦过以后会甜；

pairs.target: xiě qǐn fáng yǒu gè jiào pà wò de rén , shuìjiào bù dǎhūlu , què huì zài mèng lǐ gēn rén tǎojiàhuánjià .
pairs.english: about someone named Pavo in his room who didn't snore but bargained in his sleep.
pairs.hanzi: 写寝房有个叫帕沃的人，睡觉不打呼噜，却会在梦里跟人讨价还价。

pairs.target: xiě dào xīn rènshi de lìngwài liǎnggè rén shí , tā tíng le tíng .
pairs.english: He paused when he reached the other two people he'd met.
pairs.hanzi: 写到新认识的另外两个人时，他停了停。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèngzài shūyè shàng chāo yìfú tú , zuǐlǐ yǎo zhe méiyòng de bǐgǎn .
pairs.english: Mira was copying a diagram onto a page, biting an unused pen shaft.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正在书页上抄一幅图，嘴里咬着没用的笔杆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān xiě le tā de míngzì , zài xiě yīwén , shuō tāmen qù kànguò shāngǔ lǐ de dàqiáo , yě yìqǐ tī guò qiú .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote her name first, then Iven's, saying they'd seen the great bridge in the valley and played ball together.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先写了她的名字，再写伊文，说他们去看过山谷里的大桥，也一起踢过球。

pairs.target: shū le de shì , tā yóuyù le yíxià , háishì xiě le .
pairs.english: He hesitated about their losing, but wrote that too.
pairs.hanzi: 输了的事，他犹豫了一下，还是写了。

pairs.target: hòulái de nàchǎng mǐlā yòu yào zhòng suàn bǐfēn , zhè yìhuí tā juéde yīwén yǒu dàolǐ .
pairs.english: In their later match Mira had wanted to recalculate the score again; this time he'd thought Iven had a point.
pairs.hanzi: 后来的那场米拉又要重算比分，这一回他觉得伊文有道理。

pairs.target: búguò xìn shàng méiyǒu dìfāng bǎ zhēngzhí cóngtóu jiǎngwán , tā zhī tiān le yíjù : qiú fènghǎo le , bú tàiyuán .
pairs.english: But there was no room in the letter to explain the whole dispute, so he added only: The ball is mended. Not very round.
pairs.hanzi: 不过信上没有地方把争执从头讲完，他只添了一句：球缝好了，不太圆。

pairs.target: mǐlā náxià zuǐlǐ de bǐgǎn , hūrán wèn tā míngtiān dài shénme chī de .
pairs.english: Mira took the pen shaft from her mouth and suddenly asked what food he was bringing tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿下嘴里的笔杆，忽然问他明天带什么吃的。

pairs.target: " míngtiān ? " " qù fēnshuǐ tái . gàoshì tiē zài fàntáng ménbiān le , wéi lǎoshī dàiduì , zǎofàn hòu chūfā , zhōngwǔ cái huílái . nǐ méi kàn ? "
pairs.english: “Tomorrow?” “To the water-dividing platform. The notice is by the dining-hall door. Instructor Vey's leading us, leaving after breakfast, back at noon. Didn't you see?”
pairs.hanzi:
“明天？”
“去分水台。告示贴在饭堂门边了，维老师带队，早饭后出发，中午才回来。你没看？”

pairs.target: tā yáotóu . tā xiǎng le xiǎng , méiyǒu tì tā shuō xiàqù , děng tā bǎ zuìhòu jǐgè zì xiě wán , cái bǎ shū hé shàng .
pairs.english: He shook his head. She thought a moment, didn't speak for him, and waited until he'd finished the last few characters before closing her book.
pairs.hanzi:
他摇头。
她想了想，没有替他说下去，等他把最后几个字写完，才把书合上。

pairs.target: " zǒu , wǒmen qù kàn . shàngmiàn hái shuō dài shénme , wǒ yě wàng le . "
pairs.english: “Come on, let's go look. It said what to bring, too. I've forgotten as well.”
pairs.hanzi: “走，我们去看。上面还说带什么，我也忘了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn zhé hǎo , zhǐmiàn shàng de mò hái méi quán gān .
pairs.english: Tavi folded his letter; the ink on the paper wasn't fully dry yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信折好，纸面上的墨还没全干。

pairs.target: tā děng le yíhuìer , qīngqīng chuī zhe , zhídào chuāngwài nàtiáo cháng bù luòxiàlái , yángguāng yòu zhào huí tā de shǒubèi .
pairs.english: He waited, blowing gently, until the long cloth outside fell back and sunlight returned to the backs of his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他等了一会儿，轻轻吹着，直到窗外那条长布落下来，阳光又照回他的手背。
